description: Maintained a large production network of Linux routers and core routing infrastructure, handling on-call incidents, technical escalations, and updates while minimizing customer downtime.
highlights: Repaired and maintained 13,000 Linux routers and their uplinks on a 24/7 basis with pager rotation between a small team
Managed and troubleshot Cisco 7200 at the core, including DS3 and T1 testing and configuration
Responded to escalations from outside groups requiring thorough understanding of proprietary network design, diagnostic tools, and processes
Seamlessly administered hardware and software updates in a large production environment, ensuring low failure percentages and minimizing client downtime
